# Dave Weise 

 

### Tenure

1993 – 2015

### Signature

 David H. Weise is a former Mattel employee who worked for Mattel from 1993 to 2015. He is known for designing many fantasy cars such as 24/Seven, Radio Flyer Wagon, Baby Boomer and Power Bomb alongside his work on many series including 1/64 scale Disney/Pixar Cars pitches and prototypes. 

Dave moved to Matchbox in 2006 and designed there until 2015 when he subsequently retired. His favorite Hot Wheels are 24/Seven and Splittin' Image.

## Gallery []

 

2005 Chicago Collectors Nationals poster signed by Dave Weise, Ira Gilford, and Jerry Thienprasiddhi

Display table at the 1997 Hot Wheels Collectors Convention. The showcase features an original concept sketch for the '70 Plymouth Barracuda alongside early pre-production prototypes of the Radio Flyer Wagon.
